snippet.title: Agni: Village of Calamity - Official Gameplay Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
Step into the terrifying world of Agni: Village of Calamity in this trailer for the upcoming Indonesian horror game. The Agni: Village of Calamity trailer takes you into its unsettling world, shows gameplay, and the horrific foes you'll face. Stay for the tease at the end of the trailer, which reveals Indonesian director Joko Anwar makes a special appearance as The Headman. Agni: Village of Calamity will be available on Xbox PC and Xbox Series X/S.

Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality.
